findings.title: Critical/high advisories persist in the dev dependency tree; `next` override is mis-scoped
findings.note: re-verified at 7dd0402: package.json pnpm.overrides includes next '>=15.5.24 <16 || >=16.3.6' plus 24 others (webpack pinned 5.101.2), mirrored in pnpm-lock.yaml:23,32; audit-gate wired in .github/actions/dependency-audit/action.yml:12-17.

findings.title: No image-level container scanning; Trivy scans filesystem only
findings.note: re-verified at 7dd0402: per-image Trivy scans (scan-type image, CRITICAL/HIGH, exit-code 1) in deploy-do.yml build jobs (:228-240 etc.) and build-push.yml.

findings.title: No artifact provenance, attestation, or signing; `id-token: write` requested but unused
findings.note: re-verified at 7dd0402: per-image actions/attest-sbom + actions/attest-build-provenance (deploy-do.yml:264-274 etc.), verified fail-closed before deploy (:430-520); id-token is consumed.

findings.title: License policy not enforced in CI; non-OSI and LGPL licenses present
findings.note: re-verified at 7dd0402: scripts/license-gate.mjs over the full resolved tree via dependency-audit action.yml:19-29 (test + validate), plus dependency-review allow-licenses on PRs; exception scope/expiry self-test wired (:31-36).

findings.title: SBOM is generated but not bound to a commit or attached to releases/images
findings.note: re-verified at 7dd0402: generate-sbom.mjs binds <VERSION>+<commit> (metadata.component.version + mct:commit, :328-330, :459-462); validate-sbom floor + digest binding; release.yml attaches the lockfile SBOM; image SBOMs are digest-attested.

findings.title: Dependabot PR backlog is large and not triaged; one stale update conflicts with resolved versions
findings.note: repo-side at 7dd0402: dependabot-triage-reminder.yml keeps a deduplicated weekly issue listing open PRs; SLA documented (docs/DEPENDENCY_POLICY.md); the promotion contains merged Dependabot PRs (#45, #159, #261). The live queue is not inspectable read-only.

findings.title: `licenses.json` is committed but unenforced and unverified
findings.note: re-verified at 7dd0402: licenses.json/sbom.cdx.json are untracked and guarded (dependency-audit action.yml:38-50 fails if committed); .gitignore lists them.

findings.title: Swagger UI loads an unpinned third-party script without SRI
findings.note: re-verified at 7dd0402: apps/api/src/routes/docs.ts:18,54,58 pins swagger-ui-dist version + integrity SRI + crossorigin; production route stays 404.

findings.title: Deploy-gate secret scan is a no-op on pushes to main
findings.note: re-verified at 7dd0402: same before-SHA logic as CI-P2-002 (.github/actions/secret-scan/action.yml:15-28).

findings.title: Secret scanning is diff-scoped only; no full-history scan artifact
findings.note: re-verified at 7dd0402: secret-history-scan.yml runs full-history gitleaks 8.30.1 (checksum-verified, :27-39) and uploads the JSON report as a 30-day artifact (:55-59).

findings.title: Produced Terraform `prod.tfvars` is tracked despite `.gitignore` intending to exclude it
findings.note: re-verified at 7dd0402: git ls-files shows only env/*.tfvars.example tracked; .gitignore:58,63 covers env/*.tfvars and infra/terraform/**/*.tfvars.

findings.title: Scheduled full-history secret scan has no failure notification
findings.note: re-verified at 7dd0402: secret-history-scan.yml:61-88 notifies via ntfy/Slack and fails loudly when no channel is configured (no silent scan failure).

findings.title: Root package license remains "ISC"
findings.note: re-verified at 7dd0402: docs/LICENSE_POLICY.md:82-88 documents ISC as intentional for the root + workspaces; allowlist includes ISC.

findings.title: e2e Docker image is not digest-pinned
findings.note: re-verified at 7dd0402: e2e.yml installs Playwright via pnpm exec (no container image); the root compose e2e profile image is digest-pinned (docker-compose.yml:73) and profile-gated.

findings.title: Secret-scanner pattern sets diverge between `.sh` and `.ps1`
findings.note: re-verified at 7dd0402: scripts/scan-secrets.sh:13 and scripts/scan-secrets.ps1:7-15 carry the same 10 pattern classes; the CI composite mirrors them (.github/actions/secret-scan/action.yml:14).

findings.title: Unpinned container images (test/local only); production app images tag-based by design
findings.note: re-verified at 7dd0402: third-party compose images (redis/caddy/prometheus/alertmanager) are digest-pinned; third-party-image-scan.yml:49-57 fails on any unpinned literal ref; mct-* refs are the repo's own digest-resolved images (documented exception).

findings.title: Dockerfile lint: missing WORKDIR in web runner stage and shell-form HEALTHCHECK
findings.note: re-verified at 7dd0402: hadolint gate wired (test.yml:60, validate.yml:62; digest-pinned image) and the WORKDIR/exec-form fixes are in the Dockerfiles.

findings.title: SBOM is produced as a transient artifact, not bound to a release
findings.note: release.yml is wired to generate and attach the lockfile SBOM (release.yml:126-145) but the workflow fails on every promotion (exit 141 at the notes step; live run 38490822732), and origin has 0 releases - so no SBOM is actually attached yet. See CI-P2-011.

findings.title: A secrets file exists on disk outside git (should never be committed)
findings.note: re-verified at 7dd0402: the secret-scan composite rejects tracked .env/supabase temp files (.github/actions/secret-scan/action.yml:43-61); git ls-files shows none; .gitignore covers .env/supabase/.temp.

findings.title: gitleaks generic-api-key/jwt hits are false positives (no tracked secret)
findings.note: re-verified at 7dd0402: .gitleaks.toml uses rule-scoped allowlists for each reviewed class + scripts/ci/verify-gitleaks-config.sh proves a synthetic key is still detected (negative fixture).

findings.title: Secret scanner misses the platform's own token formats and scans diffs only
findings.note: diff scanner pattern list still lacks dop_v1_/sbp_/glpat_/sk-proj-/npm_ formats at 7dd0402 (.github/actions/secret-scan/action.yml:14; scripts/scan-secrets.sh:13); the weekly full-history gitleaks scan covers history but not these formats either.

findings.title: Dependabot has no security-update separation or triage SLA, and PR template has no enforced link to required checks
findings.note: SLA documented + triage reminder workflow exist at 7dd0402; Dependabot security-update separation is a GitHub repo setting not inspectable read-only (same residual as BP-P3-002).

findings.title: Dependency and license policy `expires` dates are not enforced by the gates
findings.note: re-verified at 7dd0402: audit-gate.mjs and license-gate.mjs treat missing/past expires as violations; both policy files carry dates; fixture self-test asserts it (dependency-audit action.yml:31-36).

findings.title: Docs instruct the broken `pnpm licenses list --json` workflow while CI uses collect-licenses.mjs
findings.note: re-verified at 7dd0402: docs/DEPENDENCY_POLICY.md:133, docs/SBOM_PROCESS.md:27,145 and docs/LICENSE_POLICY.md:101 use scripts/collect-licenses.mjs.

findings.title: SECURITY.md says neither SBOM is signed or attested, contradicting the attested image-SBOM process
findings.note: re-verified at 7dd0402: SECURITY.md:41-56 distinguishes the attested per-image SBOMs from the artifact-only lockfile SBOM.

findings.title: No automated unused/duplicate dependency check; lockfile carries 55 multi-version packages
findings.note: re-verified at 7dd0402: dependency-rescan.yml runs pnpm dedupe --check report-only and uploads dedupe-check.txt + reports (:43-72).
